title: arXiv Mathematics — latest batch, 19 November 2026
global_caveat: arXiv supplies no official trending chart. Citation and independent-attention evidence is sparse for this very recent batch, so this is an inferred notable-paper selection, not a popularity ranking; claims are preprint claims and proofs were not independently checked.

sections.title: A Poisson boundary solution to Connes' bicentralizer conjecture and Kadison's problem on MASA
sections.abstract: For inclusions of countably decomposable von Neumann algebras with a normal faithful conditional expectation, the author proves a weak Dixmier property for the continuous core and derives new proofs of Connes' bicentralizer conjecture and a solution to Kadison's MASA problem under additional hypotheses.
sections.claimed_result: The author proves the weak Dixmier property for M ⊂ c(P) whenever M ⊂ P has a normal faithful conditional expectation, and invokes Haagerup's and Marrakchi's characterizations for the stated conjecture results.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: M and P are countably decomposable von Neumann algebras with a normal faithful conditional expectation; the Kadison result additionally assumes separable preduals and M' ∩ P = Z(M).
sections.unique_caveat: Author-claimed preprint result; proof not checked here. The paper describes its proof as independent of a recent proof of Connes' conjecture.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Claims consequences for two structural problems and introduces a Poisson-boundary framework across operator algebras and dynamics; introduction and theorem statements inspected.

sections.title: Low Moments, Small Balls and Star Discrepancy
sections.abstract: For point sets in fixed dimension, the paper gives sharp lower bounds for L^q discrepancy when 0 < q ≤ 1, improves several L∞ discrepancy bounds, and proves a higher-dimensional Haar small-ball inequality up to a polylogarithmic factor.
sections.claimed_result: The author proves the optimal order (log N)^((d−1)/2) for L^q discrepancy for every fixed d ≥ 2 and 0 < q < ∞, including the q = 1 case highlighted as answering Chen's problem; the paper also proves the stated small-ball and L∞ results.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: N points in [0,1)^d, with fixed dimension d; the small-ball statement is for d ≥ 3 and incurs a power-of-logarithm loss.
sections.unique_caveat: The small-ball inequality retains a polylogarithmic loss; the lower-bound constant tends to zero as q → 0, and the paper leaves open whether this is necessary.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Addresses named discrepancy and small-ball problems with a sharp-order theorem and improved upper bounds; introduction and main-results statements inspected.

sections.title: Infinite cascades for the defocusing cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the square torus
sections.abstract: For every 1 < s < 2, the author constructs a global solution on the square two-torus whose H^s norm grows without bound from one fixed initial datum, with growth that can be made arbitrarily slow.
sections.claimed_result: For each 1 < s < 2, a global solution has ||u(t)||_{H^s} → ∞; its squared norm can track the number of selected frequencies activated by time, up to bounded error, while growing more slowly than any prescribed diverging nondecreasing function.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: The defocusing cubic NLS on the square two-torus, with initial data in H^s, 1 < s < 2.
sections.unique_caveat: The result concerns super-H^1 Sobolev norms in this specific periodic equation; it does not assert growth of the conserved energy or H^1 norm.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: The introduction ties a fixed-initial-data growth question to a precise construction; introduction and main theorem statements inspected.

sections.title: A disproof of the van Emde Boas--Kruyswijk conjecture on the Davenport constant
sections.abstract: The authors disprove the conjecture D(C_n^r) = r(n−1)+1 by showing that D(C_6^r) > 5r+1 for every r ≥ 23.
sections.claimed_result: For every r ≥ 23, the Davenport constant of C_6^r is strictly greater than the conjectured value 5r+1.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Finite abelian groups of the form C_6^r; the lower bound is asserted for ranks at least 23.
sections.unique_caveat: The counterexample concerns a specific family and does not determine the exact Davenport constant there or settle the formula for other n and r.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: A concrete counterexample to a conjecture dating to 1969, cross-listed in combinatorics and number theory.

sections.title: Sharpness of the Osgood threshold for anomalous dissipation and non-uniqueness in passive scalar transport
sections.abstract: For every concave non-Osgood modulus of continuity, the authors construct a divergence-free velocity field producing anomalous dissipation and, as a corollary, non-uniqueness among bounded transport solutions.
sections.claimed_result: The authors show the Osgood condition is sharp for anomalous dissipation and for uniqueness of bounded solutions to the transport equation under the modulus and divergence-free hypotheses stated in the abstract.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: The modulus is concave and non-Osgood; the velocity lies in L∞([0,1]; C^ω(T²)) and is divergence-free, with smooth initial data for the dissipation construction.
sections.unique_caveat: Concavity matters: the paper notes pathological non-Osgood moduli for which the corresponding velocity class is uniformly log-Lipschitz. The constructed velocity may depend on the initial data.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Resolves a stated sharp-threshold question and combines dissipation with bounded-solution non-uniqueness in one PDE setting.

sections.title: Higher-order estimates for p-harmonic functions in the plane
sections.abstract: The authors establish uniform interior higher-order Hölder estimates for planar p-harmonic functions in 1 < p < 2, below an optimal regularity order, with consequences for critical points, Liouville theorems, and fluxes.
sections.claimed_result: For every integer k ≥ 2 and 0 < β < 1 with k + β < s(p), the authors prove uniform interior C^{k,β} estimates and derive critical-point, Liouville, and flux consequences.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Planar p-harmonic functions with 1 < p < 2; the estimate requires k + β < s(p), where s(p) is the optimal regularity order identified by Iwaniec and Manfredi.
sections.unique_caveat: The stated range excludes k + β = s(p) and p ≥ 2; the linked Lean formalization is a proof artifact, not independent peer review.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: The abstract describes a longstanding regularity gap and explicit estimates; the arXiv comment links public Lean formalization code.

sections.title: Cameron--Martin theorem for SLE welding measures
sections.abstract: For κ ∈ (0,4], the author identifies the Weil--Petersson group as exactly the quasi-invariance group of the welding law induced by SLE loop measure under composition on either side, and gives an explicit Radon--Nikodym derivative.
sections.claimed_result: The author proves mutual absolute continuity exactly when both composing maps lie in the Weil--Petersson group, singularity otherwise, and proves this group is its own normalizer in orientation-preserving circle homeomorphisms.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: SLE parameter κ ∈ (0,4]; the law is the welding law induced by SLE loop measure, with simultaneous left and right composition.
sections.unique_caveat: The result is stated only for κ ∈ (0,4] and the specified welding law; the 152-page preprint's proof is not assessed here.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: The exact quasi-invariance characterization links SLE welding, conformal geometry, and Weil--Petersson structure; three-category cross-listing.

sections.title: A Weinstein manifold without any spherical Fukaya category
sections.abstract: After attaching a subcritical handle to T*P², the author constructs a Weinstein eight-manifold homotopy equivalent to S⁴ whose cotangent-fibre wrapped Floer endomorphism algebra has no spherical refinement, obstructing a wrapped Fukaya category over the sphere spectrum.
sections.claimed_result: The author shows the integral wrapped Floer endomorphism algebra admits no spherical refinement for any brane structure, yielding the stated obstruction for the constructed manifold.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: A particular Weinstein manifold obtained from T*P² by attaching a subcritical handle; the conclusion concerns a wrapped Fukaya category over the sphere spectrum.
sections.unique_caveat: This is a specific constructed obstruction and does not imply that wrapped Fukaya categories fail to exist for Weinstein manifolds generally.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: The claimed obstruction is a concrete counterexample to a category-existence expectation, cross-listed in symplectic geometry and algebraic topology.

sections.title: On Hilbert's tenth problem for number fields
sections.abstract: The authors show that abc over a quadratic number field implies the integers are Diophantine in it; for general number fields they add an elliptic-curve rank condition.
sections.claimed_result: For quadratic K, abc over K implies Z is Diophantine in K and hence a negative answer to Hilbert's tenth problem; for arbitrary K the same conclusion assumes abc over K and a positive-rank elliptic curve over Q whose rank does not increase over K.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Number fields K; conditional on the abc conjecture over K, and for the general-field statement also on the specified elliptic curve.
sections.unique_caveat: The abc conjecture is unproved, so this is not an unconditional negative answer for these fields.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: A conditional route to Diophantine definability, cross-listed in number theory and logic, with hypotheses explicit in the abstract.

sections.title: Two almost sure upper bounds for sums of random multiplicative functions
sections.abstract: For squarefree and completely multiplicative Rademacher models, the author proves almost-sure upper bounds with (log log x)^(1/4+ε) factors for two sums and records near-matching large values for the weighted sum.
sections.claimed_result: For every ε > 0, the author proves |Σ_{n≤x} f(n)/√n| ≪ (log log x)^(1/4+ε) for the squarefree model and |Σ_{n≤x} g(n)| ≪ √x(log log x)^(1/4+ε) for its completely multiplicative extension, almost surely.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: The random functions are squarefree or extended Rademacher multiplicative functions; the bounds are almost-sure statements for every fixed ε > 0.
sections.unique_caveat: The bounds concern specified random models and do not directly establish analogous bounds for the Möbius function or other deterministic multiplicative functions.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: The abstract gives almost-sure bounds; the comment says this submission supersedes 2501.11076v4 with an improvement and streamlined proof, and the paper is cross-listed in number theory and probability.
